vocabulary.example: When did you speak to him?

vocabulary.meaning_en: in what way; also how much, how many, how difficult
vocabulary.example: How did you make the cake?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a question word that asks about place, time, reason or way: where, when, why, how
the situation (time, place, reason) that helps people understand
vocabulary.example: Give the time and place so people understand the context.
Clear communication is important at work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a way of communicating where you listen carefully and give clear details (when, where, how)
vocabulary.example: Active listening helps people understand each other.
What was the reason for the delay?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the steps you take to do something
vocabulary.example: Explain the process step by step.
"How difficult is it?" asks about intensity.

vocabulary.meaning_en: able to be used in many ways

vocabulary.example: She explained the process step by step.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a review to help you remember something
vocabulary.example: This lesson is a good refresher.
Saying "right now" gives a sense of urgency.

fine_lines.title: when vs how much time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: when تسأل عن وقت محدد (الماضي أو الحاضر أو المستقبل). how much time تسأل عن مقدار الوقت (المدة). لا نقول when time.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "When" asks for a point in time (past, present, future). "How much time" asks about the amount of time. Don't say "when time".

examples.sentence: How much time do you need?

fine_lines.title: why vs how
fine_lines.explanation_ar: why تسأل عن السبب. how تسأل عن الطريقة والخطوات (العملية).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Why" asks for the reason. "How" asks for the way or the steps (the process).

examples.sentence: Why did he lose control of the car? He was very tired.
How did it happen? The car slid on the ice and hit a wall.

expressions.phrase: How much money do you need?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking about an amount of money.
expressions.example: How much money do you need for the trip?
How difficult is the new job?

expressions.meaning_en: Asking about the place of an event.
expressions.example: I heard about the accident. Where did it happen?
The train was late. Why did it happen?

grammar.title: where + when = basic context
grammar.explanation_ar: عند الحديث أو الكتابة ابدأ بالمكان (where) والزمان (when) ليفهم السامع ما تقصده. كثير من الناس ينسونهما لأن المعلومة في رؤوسهم فقط.
grammar.explanation_en: When you speak or write, start with the place (where) and the time (when) so the listener understands. Many people forget them because the information is only in their head.
examples: Yesterday (when), in the office (where), you spoke to me loudly.

grammar.title: why = reason, how = process
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد المكان والزمان، يضيف why السبب، ويضيف how الخطوات والطريقة. السبب قد يغيّر رأينا تمامًا في ما حدث.
grammar.explanation_en: After place and time, "why" adds the reason and "how" adds the steps or the way. The reason can completely change how we see an event.
examples: Why was he late? His bus broke down.
How did you fix it? First I turned it off, then...

grammar.title: how for quantity and intensity
grammar.explanation_ar: how كلمة متعددة الاستعمالات: how much / how many للكمية، و how + صفة للشدة: how difficult, how bright, how large.
grammar.explanation_en: "How" is versatile: how much / how many for quantity; how + adjective for intensity: how difficult, how bright, how large.
examples: How much time do you need?

grammar.title: Question word + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد أداة الاستفهام يأتي الفعل (أو الفعل المساعد) ثم الفاعل: Where is he? When are you leaving? How is your mother?
grammar.explanation_en: After the question word comes the verb (or helping verb), then the subject: Where is he? When are you leaving? How is your mother?

questions.question: Which two words give basic context?
questions.explanation_en: Place and time: where and when.

questions.question: "___ did the accident happen?" "On King Street."
questions.explanation_en: The answer is a place: where.

questions.question: "___ did he leave?" "Yesterday at 5."
questions.explanation_en: The answer is a time: when.

questions.question: "___ were you late?" "Because my bus broke down."
questions.explanation_en: The answer is a reason: why.

questions.question: Which question word can ask about quantity or intensity?
questions.explanation_ar: how للكمية والشدة: how much / how difficult.

questions.question: "___ time do you need?"
questions.explanation_ar: time غير معدود: how much time.

questions.question: "How" can ask about the ___, the steps someone took.
questions.explanation_en: "How" asks about the process, the steps.

questions.question: Which kind of communication uses when, where and how to give clear details?
